# Retail analytics that respects shoppers.

> Open-source, privacy-first retail analytics concept for small-format pilot stores: SKU gaps, experiments and ROI reporting, built as a TypeScript monorepo.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- The tool is not published on the public site (its docs app is passcode-gated); run it from source.

## Source

- [Source code and README](https://github.com/duncan-haywood/oss-monorepo/tree/main/ventures/retail-pilot-intel): FSL-1.1-MIT licensed.
